themes.label: Viewers require contextual sentences to learn how to apply

entries.text: Viewers require **contextual sentences** to learn how to apply vocabulary words and synonyms correctly rather than just viewing lists [1]. "let the viewers watch the video to learn using the synonyms properly in sentences ." (👍8)

themes.label: Users highly appreciate and benefit from crowdsourced, timestamped study

entries.text: Users highly appreciate and benefit from **crowdsourced, timestamped study notes** because they save learning time [2]. "Thanks a lot for saving our time. 🌺" (👍0)

entries.text: Users experience **technical access barriers** with external PDF download links failing to load [3]. "I can't open the pdf says site not reachable" (👍0)

entries.text: Viewers express **strong interest in supplementary PDFs** but need guidance on how to access them [3]. "I have interested, how can I get it" (👍0)

themes.label: Viewers require guidance on which specific vocabulary levels (such as

entries.text: Viewers require guidance on which specific vocabulary levels (such as CEFR levels A1–A2, B1–B2, or C1–C2) they should focus on studying to achieve high band scores like an IELTS 8 or higher [1]. "pls tell me which level of vocabulary I should focus on to achieve an IELTS band score of 8 or higher? Which level should I mainly study: A1–A2, B1–B2, or C1–C2 vocabulary?" (👍0)

themes.label: Viewers need direct links or clear navigation to locate recommended

entries.text: Viewers need direct links or clear navigation to locate recommended follow-up video resources mentioned by the instructor at the end of the lesson [2]. "Where is the video that you mentioned in the end of the video ?" (👍0)

themes.label: Viewers request Swedish or Persian subtitles to help them

entries.text: Viewers request Swedish or Persian subtitles to help them comprehend video content better. "Could you please activate Swedish or Persian subtitles too? It would really help me understand better." (👍0) [1]

themes.label: Viewers request future lessons covering advanced or more difficult

entries.text: Viewers request future lessons covering advanced or more difficult English vocabulary. "i want a video of , advanced or tough words in english.." (👍0) [2]

themes.label: Native French speakers find learning advanced English synonyms easier

entries.text: Native French speakers find learning advanced English synonyms easier due to linguistic roots and similarities shared with French. "In fact, many synonyms are coming from french language ! ... Of course, I am french !!! It makes things easier for me..." (👍2) [3]

themes.label: Spanish-speaking learners experience an advantage with advanced English synonyms

entries.text: Spanish-speaking learners experience an advantage with advanced English synonyms because they often resemble familiar words in Spanish. "To me, using the advanced words is easier that using the usual ones, maybe cause they're similar to the Spanish words." (👍1) [4]

themes.label: Viewers highly value direct resource download links embedded cleanly

entries.text: Viewers highly value direct resource download links embedded cleanly in the video description or comments. "o i loved the way you drop the link of these words it really helps me out" (👍0) [5]

themes.label: Learners report that the official supplementary vocabulary PDF is

entries.text: Learners report that the official supplementary vocabulary PDF is highly effective for their preparation. "Too effective this PDF" (👍1) [6]

themes.label: Some viewers find the recommended synonyms too basic and

entries.text: Some viewers find the recommended synonyms too basic and already familiar to them. "All of these synonyms are pretty basic, and I already use some of them." (👍0) [7]

themes.label: Students struggle with their minds going blank during online

entries.text: Students struggle with their minds going blank during online mock tests and worry that exam-day anxiety will compromise their speaking performance. "But whenever I take an online mock speaking test, my mind goes blank. I'm afraid it'll happen in the real IELTS Speaking test too. 😭" (👍0) [7]

entries.text: Viewers request more synonym videos tailored specifically for IELTS Writing Task 2. "Please make more videos like this, especially for IELTS Writing Task 2." (👍0) [5]
